text:
Priya Shah: Quick check-in on Kepler Analytics onboarding health — p95 ~380ms last 48h (goal 280ms) and token cost ~+19%. Renewal intro in ~5w. Low-risk ops win idea: int8 canary + route doc/embedding-heavy requests to a compact runtime. Thoughts?
Ethan Wu: +1. Do we have route-level breakdown? is this chat vs batch?
Priya Shah: Mostly /chat/generate. Lots of long system prompts and doc lookups. I uploaded the route heatmap to the dashboard.
Samir Gupta: int8 tends to cut p95 for long-context, but quality gating is critical. Recommend 5% global canary + prefix-route any req where meta.kv_len > 1500 to `compact-s`. Also exclude billing flows.
Nadia Park: CSM wants billing-sensitive endpoints excluded and a one-paragraph customer-facing note. Also capture p99 and hallucination rate.
Priya Shah: Ops-safe rollout snippet for SREs: ```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "policy": "canary", "canary": {"pct": 5, "model": "kepler-int8-rc1", "exclude_tags": ["billing_sensitive"]}},
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "policy": "route", "match": {"meta.kv_len": {"gt": 1500}, "meta.priority": "low"}, "model": "redwood-compact-s"}
  ]
}
```
Ethan Wu: @ops-bot please run perf-smoke compare kepler-int8-rc1 vs kepler-fp16 on 500 anonymized prod traces. Include p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta.
ops-bot: Scheduled job #40567: perf-smoke/kepler-int8. Samples: 500. ETA ~30m. I will post results in this thread.
Samir Gupta: Quality gate: run `eval-suite run --customer kepler --suite onboarding-critical --min-avg 0.96` 16fail triggers auto-rollback. Also track hallucination and exact-match for 12 anchor prompts.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/40567 complete 16summary: int8 p95 -15%, p99 -7%, token cost per req -13%. Eval-suite avg quality = 96.8% on onboarding-critical. Logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/40567
Priya Shah: Those numbers look good and align with our targets. Proposed ramp: 24h @5% -> 24h @25% (low-priority docs) -> 48h @50% overall. Auto-rollback if eval <96% or p99 increases.
Ethan Wu: Agree. Also schedule a short UAT with Kepler ops during a low-traffic window and capture a one-line ops quote after 25% step for renewal slides.
Samir Gupta: I'll draft a rollback playbook with exact commands to flip rules and revoke model aliases, plus a troubleshooting checklist (latency spike, rate errors, divergence).
Nadia Park: I'll prepare the customer-facing one-pager and update the renewal slide with before/after expected numbers (-13% cost, p95 target <280ms).
Priya Shah: Action items: Priya -> coordinate UAT window & customer note; Samir -> rollback playbook & runbook; Ethan -> perf numbers for renewal deck; Nadia -> CSM one-pager + SRE exclusion list.
Ethan Wu: Add: capture a short customer quote on latency improvement for the renewal deck.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. Posting enablement doc and SRE snippet after UAT scheduling. :rocket:
